notes: Target: JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ + PyCharm) embedded copilot with local project indexing + low-latency token streaming for completions.
Architecture preference: hybrid — local lightweight quantized model for completions + hosted fallback for expensive ops (long-code generation, embeddings refresh).
Key perf goal: median completion latency <50ms inside editor typahead; 95th percentile <120ms under 100 concurrent devs.
Indexing: want fast incremental local index built from project symbols + recent commit history; embeddings stored locally (vector DB in user workspace) or in-customer VPC depending on deployment.
Model/version pinning: per-workspace pinning required; ability to roll back to previous model versions without re-indexing preferred.
POC notes: prototype uses 7B quantized model running on local dev VM for completions — initial perf promising but cold-cache penalties on monorepos.
Security/Compliance: must demonstrate SOC2 controls, KMS integration for keys, SSO/SAML for enterprise seats; legal review on redistributing quantized weights ongoing.
Quote from lead engineer: 'We need completions to feel native — streaming token callbacks and tiny round-trip are non-negotiable.'
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated capacity for predictable latency but want Optimize suggestions to reduce unit cost.
Integration hints: plugin written in Kotlin, uses LSP-like bridge; asking for a thin Redwood SDK for streaming responses and KV cache hooks.
Potential upsell: Redwood Console observability and Optimize recommendations (batching profiles for background indexing jobs).
